name: evidence-viewer-unselected
goal: Give the standalone image viewer a truthful unselected state while galleries close quietly.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: At 5f6aac9f7e the viewer renders no DOM when selected is null, so its unselected state cannot produce a nonblank component capture. Show an unselected message without leaving it in gallery views after close.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The catalog tests open and navigate the viewer but omit initial null selection and close. Add both existing component scenario states and assert that grid and entity-state galleries remain quiet and reopen correctly.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red record 2211ad05b3cb: after the close action the unselected message was absent.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Render a localized unselected message and let the two galleries unmount their viewer on close.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Green record 2a2487b96eca: the same browser command and inputs pass at the fix commit.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
